name: Run tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    name: Build all projects to test the code
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'

      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: 'zulu'
          java-version: '17'

      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@v4
        with:
          # Keep command-line tools 16.0 with the existing Java 17 setup.
          cmdline-tools-version: '12266719'
          # The legacy 'tools' package is no longer available.
          packages: 'platform-tools'
      
      - name: Install workloads for Mobile and Wasm projects
        run: |
          dotnet workload restore ./src/Avalonia.Samples/CompleteApps/AdvancedToDoList/AdvancedToDoList.Android/AdvancedToDoList.Android.csproj
          dotnet workload restore ./src/Avalonia.Samples/CompleteApps/AdvancedToDoList/AdvancedToDoList.Browser/AdvancedToDoList.Browser.csproj
          dotnet workload restore ./src/Avalonia.Samples/CompleteApps/AdvancedToDoList/AdvancedToDoList.iOS/AdvancedToDoList.iOS.csproj
        working-directory: ./

      - name: Build all solutions with diagnostics
        run: |
          $solutions = Get-ChildItem -Path "./src/Avalonia.Samples" -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.sln', '.slnx' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
          foreach ($solution in $solutions) {
            Write-Host "=== Restoring: $solution ==="
            dotnet restore $solution --ignore-failed-sources --verbosity:detailed
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
            Write-Host "=== Building: $solution ==="
            dotnet build $solution --no-restore --verbosity:detailed
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          }
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          MSBUILDSINGLEPROCESSBUILD: "1"
          DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_PROFILE: "True"
          NUGET_VERBOSITY: "detailed"

      - name: Run all tests
        run: |
          $solutions = Get-ChildItem -Path "./src/Avalonia.Samples" -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.sln', '.slnx' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
          $failed = $false
          foreach ($solution in $solutions) {
            Write-Host "=== Testing: $solution ==="
            dotnet test $solution --no-build --verbosity:normal --filter "FullyQualifiedName!~Appium"
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
              Write-Error "Tests failed for solution: $solution"
              $failed = $true
            }
          }
          if ($failed) {
            exit 1
          }
        shell: pwsh

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
